## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive (Energy, Technology). Mixed internals and major divergences across large caps (tech leaders like NVDA/CRM ABOVE TREND vs GOOGL/AMZN BELOW TREND) provide two independent confirmations for a neutral regime.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: CVX (1W: +5.78% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +9.01% | 1M: +15.00%) ABOVE TREND. Technology is also positive with CRM (1W: +24.95% | 1M: +34.53%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +7.04% | 1M: +5.88%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Industrials lag: HON (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -16.92%) BELOW TREND, GE (1W: -7.02% | 1M: -12.66%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary and Financials are weak on the week (e.g., MAR (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -3.30%) BELOW TREND; PYPL (1W: -11.55% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: CRM (1W: +24.95% | 1M: +34.53%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +10.06% | 1M: +13.12%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +9.01% | 1M: +15.00%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +15.73%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +7.04% | 1M: +5.88%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Technology) — Growth/Momentum tilt.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: HON (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -16.92%) BELOW TREND, ETN (1W: -6.82% | 1M: -11.91%) BELOW TREND, GE (1W: -7.02% | 1M: -12.66%) BELOW TREND, MNST (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -52.52%) BELOW TREND, MAR (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -3.30%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Industrials and select Consumer Discretionary names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Largest 1W movers: CRM (1W: +24.95% | 1M: +34.53%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +10.06% | 1M: +13.12%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +9.01% | 1M: +15.00%) ABOVE TREND; watch for major divergence signals from stocks with 1W/1M mismatches (KHC, V, MA, LLY) that suppress strong trend calls.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed but supportive: AAPL (1W: +3.67% | 1M: +5.13%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +1.00%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +7.04% | 1M: +5.88%) ABOVE TREND while GOOGL (1W: -1.43% | 1M: -10.73%) BELOW TREND and AMAT (1W: -8.61% | 1M: -19.70%) BELOW TREND — Technology is one of only two positive sectors this week.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Cautious/weak: JPM (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -0.36%) BELOW TREND, PYPL (1W: -11.55% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND and V (1W: -1.43% | 1M: +2.57%) showing TREND EXHAUSTION; Financials on the week are negative and not confirming broader risk-on.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Mixed with defensive pockets: JNJ (1W: +1.93% | 1M: +8.49%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +2.54% | 1M: +14.21%) ABOVE TREND, while UNH (1W: -0.34% | 1M: -1.94%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -2.47% | 1M: +4.13%) shows TREND EXHAUSTION.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Remain selective within a neutral stance: favor Energy leaders (CVX, SLB) and high-conviction Tech momentum (CRM, NVDA) while reducing exposure to lagging Industrials and beaten Consumer Discretionary names. Monitor large-cap divergences and sentiment-driven names for tactical opportunities rather than broad reallocation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: CRM (1W: +24.95% | 1M: +34.53%) ABOVE TREND — follow-through critical; NVDA (1W: +7.04% | 1M: +5.88%) ABOVE TREND — momentum to confirm; CVX (1W: +5.78% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND — energy strength.  
BEARISH: PYPL (1W: -11.55% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -8.61% | 1M: -19.70%) BELOW TREND, HON (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -16.92%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (one of 2/11 positive sectors) — breadth and leaders confirming. Technology (positive on week) — watch whether leadership broadens.  
BEARISH: Industrials and Consumer Discretionary — notable weakness and several names BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA (1W: +7.04% | 1M: +5.88%) ABOVE TREND — sustain above this week’s breakout to confirm continuation. CRM (1W: +24.95% | 1M: +34.53%) ABOVE TREND — need follow-through next week to validate the breakout. PYPL (1W: -11.55% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND — failure to regain 1M trend signals further downside risk. HON (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -16.92%) BELOW TREND — breach of recent support would deepen industrials weakness.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
GOOGL (+75): Google launches Gemini 3.8 — GOOGL (1W: -1.43% | 1M: -10.73%) BELOW TREND — bullish news but price still BELOW TREND (divergence).  
MSFT (+55): large backlog headline — MSFT (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +1.00%) ABOVE TREND — news confirming price action.  
LMT (+60): Pentagon deal — (no dual-time data in top/detail lists) monitor for follow-through.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
BA (-60): Boeing’s deal concerns — BA (1W: -1.52% | 1M: -11.93%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirms price weakness.  
AAPL (-50): UK lawsuit headline — AAPL (1W: +3.67% | 1M: +5.13%) ABOVE TREND — negative news but price still ABOVE TREND (divergence).  
WMT (-45): DOJ beef-price probe — WMT (1W: +1.68% | 1M: -4.67%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — news increases downside risk.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Growth/Momentum tilt driven by Technology and Energy leadership. CRM (1W: +24.95% | 1M: +34.53%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +7.04% | 1M: +5.88%) ABOVE TREND and CVX (1W: +5.78% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk is the large-cap divergence and mixed news flow (e.g., GOOGL bullish news while BELOW TREND; AAPL negative headlines while ABOVE TREND) — monitor for confirmation before broadening exposure.
